# Sam Houston State University

> > Sam Houston State University (SHSU) is a comprehensive public university in Huntsville, Texas, offering undergraduate and graduate programs across nine colleges with strengths in forensic science, criminal justice, online education, and research partnerships with the National Institute of Justice and NSF.

SHSU serves as a Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) and military-friendly university with campuses in Huntsville and Conroe, Texas. The university emphasizes student success, hands-on research, and flexible online degree programs through SHSU Online, while maintaining strong partnerships in forensic science, biomedical research, and industry collaboration.

## Colleges and Academic Programs

- [Our Colleges](https://www.shsu.edu//academics/colleges/index.php): Overview of 9 SHSU colleges across Huntsville and Conroe campuses

- [Creative Spaces & Facilities](https://www.shsu.edu//academics/colleges/arts-media/facilities.php): College of Arts and Media studios, theaters, and Gaertner Performing Arts

## Online Education

- [SHSU Online | Advance Your Career from Anywhere](https://www.shsu.edu//academics/online/index.php): SHSU Online accredited programs for flexible distance learning nationwide
- [Build the Future - Earn Your Degree Online](https://www.shsu.edu//academics/online/whats-next/build-the-future.php): Online degree programs in business, engineering, and technology
- [Lead with Impact - Earn Your Degree Online](https://www.shsu.edu//academics/online/whats-next/lead-with-impact.php): Online leadership programs in business, healthcare, and criminal justice
